correctness.rationale: The proof was independently reconstructed. Eliminating a and b by the two weighted normal equations gives a one-variable rational objective phi=N/D. Cauchy--Binet gives generic degrees deg N=deg D=2n-4, so the induced map P1 to P1 has total ramification 4n-10. On the rank-one locus a=bc, the first two normal equations force b to the sample mean and reduce the remaining condition to a degree n-2 polynomial; the third critical equation factors by the rank defect, and genericity makes those n-2 roots simple and disjoint from the remaining exceptional loci. Duff--Rydell's proved singular-locus theorem identifies exactly these points as singular-image criticals, leaving 3n-8 smooth ED-critical image tuples. Fresh exact rational reconstructions for n=4,5,6 gave degree tuples (4,4,6,2,4), (6,6,10,3,7), and (8,8,14,4,10) for N,D,J,S,J/S and verified coprimality/divisibility; these finite checks corroborate rather than replace the generic proof.

residual_risks: The theorem is generic and does not determine nongeneric configurations, other camera dimensions or alternative metrics.
